about.title: Modernizing Residential Property Operations Across Cambodia
about.lead: RentEase was built to replace fragmented chats, paper agreements, and manual rent spreadsheets with a unified, transparent operating platform designed specifically for landlords, residents, and field service teams.
about.challenge_p1: In rapidly expanding urban centers across Cambodia, property leasing has traditionally relied on fragmented messaging apps, paper receipts that get misplaced, and informal maintenance requests that go untracked.
about.challenge_p2: This lack of operational structure creates disputes over deposit refunds, payment status confusion, unverified listing details, and delayed repairs for residents.
about.solution_p1: RentEase introduces end-to-end transparency: verified unit inventories with OpenFreeMap vector positioning, digital tenancy applications, enforceable digital leases, automated monthly invoicing, and structured maintenance dispatch.
about.solution_p2: Every transaction produces an immutable record, ensuring landlords, tenants, and technicians operate with mutual trust and clarity.
about.pillars_subtitle: RentEase is built as a production-grade modular monolith adhering to strict type safety, data isolation, and enterprise flat UI design.
about.pillar_map_desc: Interactive vector tiles provide accurate property and unit visualization across Phnom Penh, Siem Reap, Sihanoukville, and Kampot without third-party tracking.
about.pillar_sec_desc: Multi-tenant data isolation ensures landlords, tenants, technicians, and administrators access only authorized records backed by cryptographically secure sessions.
about.pillar_life_desc: From verified listing discovery to application vetting, digital lease execution, and automated monthly invoicing with digital payment receipts.
about.pillar_maint_desc: Structured repair workflows enable residents to report issues with photographs while field technicians manage on-site task queues with clear SLAs.
about.stakeholders_title: Built for the Entire Rental Ecosystem
about.stakeholders_subtitle: Every user group accesses dedicated tools tailored specifically to their daily operational responsibilities.
about.landlord_desc: Consolidate multiple complexes, track unit occupancy rates, automate recurring rent cycles, and maintain legal lease documentation in one place.
about.tenant_desc: Search verified vacancies, inspect detailed room specifications, sign enforceable leases digitally, and pay invoices with instant digital receipts.
about.tech_desc: Receive dispatched maintenance work orders with unit access notes, update repair milestones, and document completed repairs on site.
about.admin_desc: Maintain system integrity, monitor cross-organization tenancy health, manage user account roles, and inspect immutable audit trails.
about.regions_subtitle: RentEase supports residential complexes, serviced apartments, and residential estates across major urban centers.

faq.banner_desc: Our support team is available to assist landlords, residents, and technicians with account setup, listings, or technical inquiries.

items.q_account_1: How do I register for a Landlord or Tenant account?
items.a_account_1: Navigate to the Register page, choose whether you want to register as a Tenant (to browse vacancies, apply, and pay rent) or Landlord (to list properties, screen tenants, and collect rent), enter your full name, email, password, and review the Terms & Conditions and Privacy Policy.
items.q_account_2: How does RentEase protect my account credentials?
items.a_account_2: RentEase uses the cryptographic scrypt algorithm with individual random salts to hash passwords. Sessions are managed via secure, cryptographically random 32-byte tokens sent exclusively over HTTP-only, SameSite cookies to protect against cross-site scripting (XSS) and unauthorized token theft.
items.q_account_3: Can I switch roles between Landlord and Tenant?
items.a_account_3: Account roles (Tenant, Landlord, Technician, Admin) enforce strict data isolation and permission boundaries. If you require access as both a landlord and a tenant, we recommend creating distinct accounts associated with your respective contact details.
items.q_property_1: How do I search for rental vacancies across Cambodia?
items.a_property_1: Visit the Browse Properties page or the interactive Map Explorer to filter vacancies by city (Phnom Penh, Siem Reap, Sihanoukville, Kampot), bedroom count (1 Bed, 2 Beds, 3+ Beds), and budget range. Clicking any property reveals individual unit floor numbers, sizes, rental rates, and photographic galleries.
items.q_property_2: How does OpenFreeMap work on RentEase?
items.a_property_2: RentEase integrates open-source, privacy-friendly OpenFreeMap vector tiles. You can pan, zoom, inspect property location pins, and view accurate neighborhood context without any personal location tracking or external ad trackers.
items.q_property_3: How do landlords add new properties and units?
items.a_property_3: Landlords can click "Add Property" from their dashboard to input property titles, addresses, city selections, coordinates, and amenities. Once created, individual units with unit numbers, floor levels, square footage, bedrooms, bathrooms, rent amounts, and security deposits can be added to the property inventory.
items.q_app_1: How do tenants apply for an available unit?
items.a_app_1: Tenants viewing an available unit can click "Apply for Unit" to submit a tenancy application. The application captures your declared monthly income, employment details, requested lease start date, and emergency contact details.
items.q_app_2: What happens after I submit a rental application?
items.a_app_2: The property landlord receives an automated notification in their dashboard under Applications. The landlord reviews your application status (PENDING -> UNDER_REVIEW) and can approve or decline the submission. Approved applications can immediately be converted into a digital lease.
items.q_lease_1: How are digital lease agreements signed on RentEase?
items.a_lease_1: When a landlord approves an application, they generate a Lease Agreement with agreed rent, security deposit, and start/end dates. The lease enters PENDING_SIGNATURES status. Both the landlord and tenant review the lease terms and click "Sign Agreement". Once both signatures are recorded, the lease transitions to ACTIVE and the unit is marked RESERVED/OCCUPIED.
items.q_lease_2: Is a digital lease signed on RentEase legally binding?
items.a_lease_2: Yes. Digital execution with authenticated credentials and timestamped audit logs establishes mutual assent between the landlord and tenant under Cambodian contract principles.
items.q_lease_3: Can a lease be terminated early?
items.a_lease_3: Landlords and tenants can review active leases in the Leases dashboard. In the event of early departure or mutual agreement, landlords can initiate a lease termination, which records an audit log and returns the assigned unit to the available inventory.
items.q_payment_1: When are monthly rental invoices generated?
items.a_payment_1: Invoices are generated based on the active lease terms. Landlords can issue monthly invoices with due dates, and tenants receive immediate dashboard alerts. Invoices itemize base rent, utilities, and security deposit breakdowns.
items.a_payment_2: Yes! If a tenant pays a portion of the due amount, the landlord or platform records the partial payment. The invoice status updates to PARTIALLY_PAID, displays the remaining balance, and issues an itemized digital payment receipt.
items.q_payment_3: What happens if rent is not paid by the due date?
items.a_payment_3: If an invoice remains unpaid past the due date and grace period, the system automatically transitions its status to OVERDUE. The tenant dashboard prominently highlights the overdue balance, and audit alerts notify the property manager.
items.q_maint_1: How do residents request maintenance or repairs?
items.a_maint_1: Tenants navigate to their Maintenance dashboard, click "Request Repair", describe the problem (e.g., HVAC cooling, plumbing leak, electrical outage), select a priority (LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, EMERGENCY), and optionally upload photographs of the issue.
items.q_maint_2: How are technicians dispatched to resolve tickets?
items.a_maint_2: Landlords and dispatchers review incoming tickets and assign them to qualified field technicians. Technicians see their assigned work orders on mobile viewports with unit numbers, access notes, and issue photographs. When repairs are finished, technicians document the resolution on-site.
